posts.title: Saturday Morning Western Pulp: Street & Smith's Western Story Magazine, October 1, 1938
posts.description: "Aces Mean Death", according to the cover of this issue of STREET & SMITH'S WESTERN STORY MAGAZINE. Of course they do. Did any poker game on the cover of a Western pulp end in anything other than a shootout? Maybe so, but I don't recall any. This dramatic cover is by H.W. Scott.
